scenario: When a Salesforce opportunity moves to Closed Won, create or update the matching customer in QuickBooks with billing address, payment terms, and tax ID taken from the account record.
rule_hooks: payment terms by account tier, dedupe on tax ID

scenario: When a HubSpot contact's lifecycle stage becomes MQL, create a Salesforce lead with source, campaign, and lead score, or update the existing lead if the email already exists.
rule_hooks: MQL score threshold, email-based dedupe

scenario: After a Zoom webinar ends, read the attendee and registrant reports and upsert contacts in HubSpot, tagging attended vs. no-show and logging the webinar as a campaign touch.
rule_hooks: attendance minutes threshold for 'attended'

scenario: When a DocuSign envelope is completed, update the linked Salesforce opportunity's contract start date, term length, and signed PDF link, and set the contract status to Activated.
rule_hooks: envelope custom field mapping to opportunity ID

scenario: Import a Google Sheet of badge scans from a trade show into Salesforce as leads, attaching each to the event campaign and skipping rows whose email already belongs to an open opportunity contact.
rule_hooks: required-field validation, existing-customer exclusion list

scenario: When a quote is marked Approved in HubSpot, copy its line items (SKU, quantity, discount, ARR) into the product-level revenue forecast Google Sheet, replacing any earlier rows for the same deal.
rule_hooks: SKU-to-product-family mapping table

scenario: Each evening, read reps' Google Calendar events with external attendees and log them as meeting activities on the matching Salesforce contacts and open opportunities.
rule_hooks: external domain matching, internal-only meeting exclusion

scenario: When a Zendesk ticket for a key account is escalated to urgent priority, set an at-risk flag and latest-escalation note on the Salesforce account so the account executive sees it.
rule_hooks: key account list, priority levels that count as escalation

scenario: Daily, sync overdue invoice amounts and days past due from Xero onto the matching HubSpot company record so reps see collections status before renewal calls.
rule_hooks: aging buckets, customer ID cross-reference

scenario: When the account owner changes in Salesforce, update the company owner in HubSpot, the assigned agent group for that org in Freshdesk, and the AE column in the account roster sheet.
rule_hooks: user ID mapping across apps

scenario: When RevOps updates the territory assignment Google Sheet, reassign Salesforce accounts whose state or employee count now falls in a different rep's territory.
rule_hooks: territory rules by region and company size

scenario: For Salesforce contracts ending within 90 days, create or update a card on the Asana renewals board with the account, ARR, end date, and CSM as assignee.
rule_hooks: 90-day renewal window, CSM assignment

scenario: When an Intercom conversation is tagged 'upgrade interest', create an expansion opportunity in HubSpot on the customer's company with the conversation link and requested plan.
rule_hooks: tag-to-pipeline mapping, existing open expansion deal check

scenario: When finance publishes the new quarterly price list in Google Sheets, update unit prices on the matching products in the Salesforce price book and deactivate discontinued SKUs.
rule_hooks: effective date, discontinued SKU list

scenario: Read new rows in the partner referral Google Form responses sheet and create HubSpot deals attributed to the referring partner, with the partner's commission tier copied from the partner roster.
rule_hooks: partner roster with commission tiers, deal registration conflict rule

scenario: When a contact's job title or email is updated in Salesforce, push the change to the matching HubSpot contact and the Zendesk user so all three systems stay consistent.
rule_hooks: Salesforce as system of record, field precedence

scenario: Weekly, copy every opportunity marked Closed Lost in the past seven days—with amount, competitor, and loss reason—into the win/loss analysis Google Sheet.
rule_hooks: standardized loss reason picklist

scenario: Every Monday, write the current Salesforce pipeline totals by stage and rep into a new dated tab of the sales leadership Google Sheet.
rule_hooks: stage-to-forecast-category mapping

scenario: When a prospect replies by Gmail, parse the email signature for phone and title and fill those fields on the HubSpot contact only where they are currently blank.
rule_hooks: fill-blank-only rule

scenario: When a deal closes in HubSpot, create the customer as an organization in Zendesk with the support plan tier and domain, and add its primary contacts as end users.
rule_hooks: plan tier to SLA policy mapping

scenario: Monthly, read active recurring invoices in QuickBooks and update the ARR field on each matching Salesforce account, noting any account where billed ARR differs from contracted ARR.
rule_hooks: ARR calculation rule, discrepancy tolerance

scenario: When a prospect books a demo through the Calendly-style booking calendar, find or create the Salesforce lead, convert it to an opportunity at the Demo Scheduled stage, and set the meeting date.
rule_hooks: lead conversion criteria, stage definitions

scenario: When a deal-desk approver marks a discount request Approved or Rejected in the Slack approvals channel's tracking sheet, update the approval status and approved discount on the Salesforce quote.
rule_hooks: discount bands requiring VP approval

scenario: When a mutual NDA envelope is completed in DocuSign, mark NDA on File with the expiration date on the Salesforce account and update the legal tracker Google Sheet row.
rule_hooks: NDA term length by template

scenario: When a Salesforce account's status changes to Churned, update the matching HubSpot company and contacts' lifecycle stage to Former Customer and remove them from customer-only email lists.
rule_hooks: lifecycle stage mapping, list membership rules

scenario: Read the weekly product usage export in Google Sheets and update seat utilization and last-active date on each Salesforce account, matched by customer ID.
rule_hooks: health score thresholds by utilization

scenario: When an opportunity is Closed Won with hardware line items, create a row in the operations order-tracking sheet and a Trello card in the Fulfillment list with ship-to address and quantities.
rule_hooks: product types that require fulfillment

scenario: When a Freshdesk ticket is tagged as a feature request, append the request to a 'Requested Features' field on any open HubSpot deal for that company so reps can tie it to deal blockers.
rule_hooks: open-deal stages, tag taxonomy

scenario: At month end, copy all Closed Won opportunities with rep, amount, product mix, and close date into the commissions Google Sheet, applying each rep's quota period.
rule_hooks: commission plan rates, split-credit rules

scenario: Sync the customer dinner RSVP Google Sheet into the Salesforce event campaign, setting member status to Accepted, Declined, or Attended and adding non-matching guests as new contacts.
rule_hooks: RSVP status to campaign status mapping

scenario: When the first invoice for a new customer is paid in Xero, update the Salesforce opportunity's 'First Payment Received' date and move the onboarding status to Ready to Kickoff.
rule_hooks: first-invoice identification, payment terms

scenario: After RevOps merges duplicate Salesforce accounts, update the surviving account ID on the HubSpot company, the QuickBooks customer reference, and re-point open Zendesk tickets to the surviving org.
rule_hooks: survivor selection rule, ID cross-reference table

scenario: After a recorded Zoom sales call ends, attach the recording link and AI summary to the related HubSpot deal and update its next-step field.
rule_hooks: meeting-to-deal matching by attendee domain

scenario: When a master services agreement is executed, copy negotiated payment terms, invoicing frequency, and PO requirement from the Salesforce contract to the QuickBooks customer profile.
rule_hooks: allowed payment terms list, PO-required flag

scenario: When an SDR marks a Salesforce lead as Sales Accepted, create the opportunity under the assigned AE, add the qualification notes, and copy the booked discovery meeting to the AE's Google Calendar.
rule_hooks: round-robin AE assignment, qualification criteria

scenario: When a customer's procurement portal confirms vendor onboarding by email, record the supplier ID and onboarding date on the Salesforce account and the AR notes in Xero.
rule_hooks: customers requiring vendor registration before invoicing

scenario: For contracts entering the 60-day renewal window, create a renewal opportunity in HubSpot with line items copied from the current contract and prices uplifted per the renewal policy.
rule_hooks: annual price uplift percentage, multi-year exceptions

scenario: When an Intercom visitor provides their work email during a chat, create or update the HubSpot contact with company, chat transcript link, and pages viewed, and assign the owner by territory.
rule_hooks: free-email domain exclusion, territory routing

scenario: When a credit note is issued in QuickBooks against a customer invoice, record the credit amount and reason on the related Salesforce opportunity and reduce its recognized booking value.
rule_hooks: credit reasons that affect bookings vs. goodwill

scenario: When a rep posts a deal update in a dedicated Slack deal-room channel using the agreed format, parse the close date, amount, and stage changes and update the matching Salesforce opportunity.
rule_hooks: channel-to-opportunity mapping, allowed stage transitions

scenario: Each Thursday, reps update commit/best-case/pipeline calls in a shared Google Sheet; the agent writes each row's forecast category and next step onto the matching Salesforce opportunity and flags rows whose opportunity ID is missing or closed.
rule_hooks: allowed category values, close date within current quarter

scenario: A recently acquired subsidiary still runs HubSpot, so its deals that reach 'Contract Sent' are created or updated as Salesforce opportunities under the parent's 'Subsidiary' record type, mapping HubSpot stages and owners to Salesforce equivalents.
rule_hooks: stage mapping table, owner email crosswalk

scenario: Unsubscribe confirmations from the HubSpot marketing account are pulled daily and the matching Salesforce contacts and leads get 'Email Opt Out' checked and the opt-out date recorded, so reps' sequences stop mailing them.
rule_hooks: consent regulations by country, global vs. per-list opt-out

scenario: Hard-bounce notifications collected in a rep's Gmail are parsed and the corresponding CRM contacts are marked 'Email Invalid' with the bounce date, and a research task is assigned to the account owner when the contact is the primary decision maker.
rule_hooks: hard vs. soft bounce codes, contact role priority

scenario: When a customer accepts a quote in the quoting tool, the agent marks that quote primary on the Salesforce opportunity and overwrites the opportunity amount, term, and products with the accepted quote's figures.
rule_hooks: single primary quote rule, amount variance tolerance

scenario: When an opportunity's expected close date moves in HubSpot, the tentative onboarding kickoff card on the implementation team's Asana board is re-dated and its capacity lane updated.
rule_hooks: kickoff offset in business days, team capacity limits

scenario: For active late-stage opportunities, the agent scans Gmail threads with the prospect's domain and adds any new CC'd stakeholders as contacts with opportunity contact roles (economic buyer, legal, procurement) in Salesforce.
rule_hooks: domain-to-account match, job title to contact-role mapping

scenario: Finance publishes the new fiscal year quota plan in Google Sheets and the agent creates or updates each rep's quarterly revenue goals in HubSpot, applying ramp percentages for reps hired mid-year.
rule_hooks: ramp schedule by tenure, quota split by quarter

scenario: Reps' out-of-office events in Google Calendar are read each morning and the agent pauses those reps in the Salesforce lead round-robin queue for the absence window and re-enables them on return.
rule_hooks: minimum absence length, backup rep per territory

scenario: Customer purchase orders arriving at the orders@ Gmail inbox are matched to their closed-won opportunity, and the PO number, PO amount, and PDF are written to the opportunity and copied to the QuickBooks customer record.
rule_hooks: PO-to-opportunity amount tolerance, required PO fields

scenario: When an account's billing contact or bill-to address changes in Salesforce, the agent updates the matching QuickBooks customer's AP email and billing address and logs the change on the account.
rule_hooks: contact role = Billing, active customers only

scenario: The weekly intent-data export dropped into Google Drive is matched to CRM accounts by domain, and each account's intent score and surging topics are updated, with a follow-up task created for owners of accounts crossing the threshold.
rule_hooks: intent score thresholds, topic relevance list

scenario: A mutual action plan Google Sheet shared with an enterprise prospect is synced so each vendor-side milestone becomes or updates a Salesforce task on the opportunity, and the opportunity's next step reflects the earliest open item.
rule_hooks: owner side (vendor vs. customer), milestone due dates

scenario: As the security team moves vendor-questionnaire tickets through their Jira workflow, the agent updates the 'Security Review Status' field on the linked opportunity and notes blocking findings.
rule_hooks: Jira status mapping, stage gate requiring approved review

scenario: Legal's contract redline tracker on a Monday.com board is synced to Salesforce so each opportunity shows current paper (ours/theirs), redline round, and expected signature date.
rule_hooks: legal stage mapping, non-standard clause flags

scenario: Proof-of-concept cards on the sales engineering Trello board carry start/end dates and success-criteria checklists; the agent copies these into the opportunity's POC fields and marks the POC outcome when the card moves to Done.
rule_hooks: maximum POC length, criteria-met percentage

scenario: Customer marketing's reference roster sheet is synced to HubSpot so accounts gain or lose the 'Reference Available' flag with permitted activities (calls, case study, logo).
rule_hooks: NPS minimum, reference usage cap per quarter

scenario: Responses from the quarterly Typeform NPS survey are matched to HubSpot companies, updating the latest NPS score and detractor flag, and adding a risk note to any open renewal deal of a detractor account.
rule_hooks: promoter/passive/detractor bands, renewal within 120 days

scenario: At month start, the agent reads the finance team's FX rate sheet and recalculates the corporate-currency (USD) amount on all open non-USD Salesforce opportunities.
rule_hooks: monthly rate table, closed opportunities locked at booking rate

scenario: When a customer emails a tax-exemption certificate, the agent records the certificate number and expiry on the CRM account and sets the QuickBooks customer as tax-exempt for the listed states.
rule_hooks: certificate state coverage, expiry date

scenario: Replies to outbound prospecting emails in reps' Gmail are classified and the matching HubSpot lead status is updated (Interested, Not Now, Wrong Person, Unsubscribe), with a referral contact created when the prospect names someone else.
rule_hooks: reply classification rules, status transition order

scenario: Leads that SDRs disqualify in Salesforce with recyclable reasons are added to the matching HubSpot nurture list by persona, and removed again if they convert.
rule_hooks: recyclable disqualification reasons, persona to list mapping

scenario: Sales engineer requests posted via a Slack workflow form are processed by assigning an SE to the opportunity team in Salesforce and copying the request's technical requirements into the opportunity.
rule_hooks: SE coverage by product line and region, minimum deal size

scenario: When a signed seat-expansion amendment comes back through DocuSign, the agent increases the seat quantity on the account's Salesforce assets and on the corresponding Xero repeating invoice, prorated for the current term.
rule_hooks: proration method, co-terming to existing renewal date

scenario: A data-ops sheet of corporate family trees (ultimate parent, subsidiaries) is applied to Salesforce by setting each account's Parent Account and rolling the subsidiary's segment up to the parent's.
rule_hooks: DUNS-based parent mapping, segment inheritance

scenario: A firmographic enrichment file with NAICS codes is matched to HubSpot companies and each company's industry picklist and vertical field are standardized from the code.
rule_hooks: NAICS-to-industry mapping table, manual-override protection

scenario: When channel managers approve partner deal registrations in the partner portal export sheet, the agent tags the matching opportunity with the partner, registration ID, and protection expiry, or creates the opportunity if none exists.
rule_hooks: channel conflict check, 90-day protection window

scenario: After leadership publishes the annual price-uplift sheet, the agent updates the amount on every open renewal opportunity in Salesforce by its product tier's uplift percentage.
rule_hooks: uplift % by tier, contractual price-increase caps

scenario: The nightly product-trial signup export is scanned for product-qualified users and the agent creates or updates HubSpot contacts with trial usage metrics, assigning them to the owner of the existing company where one exists.
rule_hooks: PQL activity criteria, existing-account ownership

scenario: New requesters who open Zendesk tickets from customer domains are added as contacts under the matching Salesforce account, so account teams can see newly active users.
rule_hooks: email domain to account match, exclude free-mail domains

scenario: Opportunities closed-lost for timing or budget reasons get a future-dated re-contact task in HubSpot and a calendar hold on the owner's Google Calendar ahead of the prospect's stated next budget cycle.
rule_hooks: loss-reason codes, re-contact interval by reason

scenario: A verified data-erasure request received in the privacy Gmail inbox is processed by deleting or anonymizing the person in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Mailchimp and logging completion in the privacy request sheet.
rule_hooks: identity verification, legal hold for active contracts

scenario: For a closed-won multi-year deal with a ramped price schedule, the agent sets up the corresponding Xero repeating invoices (amounts, start dates, frequency) from the opportunity's billing schedule fields.
rule_hooks: billing frequency, ramp year amounts

scenario: Marketing's quarterly ABM target sheet is applied to Salesforce by setting each account's ABM tier and campaign, and clearing the tier from accounts that dropped off the list.
rule_hooks: tier criteria, ownership conflicts with existing deals

scenario: UTM parameters captured on website demo-request forms are translated into Salesforce lead source, lead source detail, and campaign attribution for each newly created lead.
rule_hooks: UTM-to-source mapping table, first-touch precedence

scenario: When an AWS Marketplace private-offer acceptance email arrives, the agent closes the matching opportunity as won, sets the channel to Marketplace, and records the net amount after marketplace fees.
rule_hooks: marketplace fee percentage, offer ID to opportunity match

scenario: When a professional-services SOW is closed-won, the agent creates or updates the matching project in the PS team's project tool with the contracted hours by role and the budget derived from the rate card.
rule_hooks: role rate card, fixed-fee vs. time-and-materials

scenario: Finance's credit-review sheet results are applied by setting each new customer's credit limit and credit-hold flag in QuickBooks and mirroring the approved credit tier on the Salesforce account.
rule_hooks: credit tier to limit mapping, hold criteria

scenario: Once a quote is approved in HubSpot, the agent creates a DocuSign envelope from the order form template, prefilling customer legal name, address, term, and pricing, and routes it to the right internal countersigner.
rule_hooks: signing authority by contract value, required envelope fields

scenario: Results from the compliance team's export-control screening sheet are written to each Salesforce account's screening status, and quotes on accounts with a potential match are put on hold.
rule_hooks: screening result categories, embargoed country list
